tests.name: Runtime
tests.question: Can Infrastry start and keep the application process reachable?

tests.name: Dynamic port
tests.question: Does the platform supply and route the application port correctly?

tests.name: Environment injection
tests.question: Do configured environment values reach the running application?

tests.name: Writable storage
tests.question: Can the running application read and write its assigned data directory?

tests.name: Storage persistence
tests.question: Does application filesystem state survive an independent deployment or restart?

tests.name: Database connection
tests.question: Can the application connect to the managed PostgreSQL dependency?

tests.name: Database persistence
tests.question: Does managed PostgreSQL preserve identity and existing data across application replacement?

tests.name: Restart recovery
tests.question: Does the service recover successfully across independent process boots?

tests.name: Graceful shutdown
tests.question: Does application replacement provide a measurable graceful termination path?

tests.name: HTTPS proxy
tests.question: Does the public proxy deliver HTTPS correctly to the application?

tests.name: WebSocket proxy
tests.question: Do WebSocket upgrades and echo traffic survive the public proxy?

tests.name: Readiness vs liveness
tests.question: Does platform behavior distinguish an alive process from an application that is not ready?

tests.name: Runtime log capture
tests.question: Are correlated stdout and stderr markers captured accurately in application logs?

tests.name: Access logging
tests.question: Are controlled HTTP responses visible and attributable in access logs?
